turns.assessment: The svc076 client alarms began at t=602.5, coincident with loss of the S11–S06 optical section used by its S11–S21 lightpath. OSC loss is reported on the corresponding span in both directions, with downstream amplifier input/preamp LOS and widespread OCH LOS. This bidirectional, abrupt loss strongly indicates a physical cable cut; unchanged pump currents argue against amplifier failure. The later S23–S13 amplifier event at t=731.9 is separate and postdates svc076's failure.

proposals.rationale: O91 directly reports OSC loss on this span while O1 reports input LOS at the immediately downstream inline amplifier. O92 and O90 show the matching loss on the opposite-direction fibre of the same cable section, as expected from a cable cut. This removes the optical lightpath supporting svc076 between S11 and S21.
A sufficiently large sudden loss could also suppress both payload and OSC, but simultaneous hard loss on both directional fibres and widespread OCH LOS favor a cut over added attenuation.
